da: Skoven har givet, hvad den kan i dag. Kom igen i morgen.
en: The forest has given what it can today. Come back tomorrow.

da: Hvælvingen mangler runeskår. Tre skal der til.
en: The vault is missing rune shards. It needs three.

da: Låst. Måske kender Fru Ugle en nøgle?
en: Locked. Maybe Mrs Owl knows a key?

da: Du er for træt til at grave. Hvil dig lidt.
en: You are too tired to dig. Rest a little.

da: Kassen er tom lige nu. Kig forbi igen om nogle dage.
en: The chest is empty for now. Come back in a few days.

da: Her er gravet nok for i dag. Prøv igen i morgen.
en: That is enough digging here for today. Try again tomorrow.

da: Skoven har givet dig noget sjældent for nylig. Kom igen om nogle dage.
en: The forest gave you something rare not long ago. Come back in a few days.
